notes:
- GIFs and images in bios and comments: A bare image or GIF link on its own line now shows the picture itself instead of a blue link, and images mixed into a sentence — like a GIF between two words — are embedded in the flow and animate inline.
- AniList links get a preview card: Pasting an anime, manga, character, staff or studio link now previews it as a card, including links with a www. host or a trailing slash that previously fell through as plain text.
- Like and comment on activity: The Activity feed's like and reply counts are now buttons. Tap the heart to like or un-like a post, or open a thread to read and post a comment without leaving the app.
- Theme screen, reorganised: Settings > Theme is now grouped into clear sections — appearance, accent colour, anime colour matching, background and motion. The custom palette and custom hue live in a single accent card, true black and canvas colour share a background card, and reverting an anime colour match back to "Immediately" works again.
- Theme switching is snappier: Dynamic colour schemes are built once per picked colour instead of on every on-screen change, so changing your accent or theme feels immediate.
